prompt: A wide establishing shot from behind, taken with a 24mm lens, captures an empty, dimly lit film set from the back of the stage. The set's skeletal framework and metal catwalks are visible in the background, a testament to the bustling world of production that lies beyond the camera's gaze. The studio lights, although present, are muted, adding to the overall sense of calm and reverence. The colour palette is subdued, with hues of red, black, and silver subtly woven throughout the scene. Candid editorial news photograph with natural film-like colour and subtle grain. No text, no logos, no watermark.
